prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar is only 1.87% on a range that is smaller than the prior five bars (RE: FAIL), which is the core mechanical requirement of a momentum burst — the range-expansion day must be visibly wider than recent bars, and this one is not. Looking at the chart, the shaded base sits near the top of a 59-session run that has already pushed GILD from ~$125 to ~$150, and the last several bars inside the box show overlapping red and green candles with no compression — the base looks more like distribution chop at highs than a tight coil. The burst bar itself is modest and unremarkable against the surrounding bars, confirming the RE failure is real, not a measurement artifact.
claude.key_risk: GILD is a large-cap biotech near multi-month highs with a 59-session, 23% run already in place; any adverse headline or broad market weakness will unwind this extended name quickly with no nearby support.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if price gaps below the burst-day close (~$146.41) or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back into the body of the base, confirming the bar was not a genuine breakout.

row.summary: GILD: +1.9% on 1.2× volume out of a base 5.9% deep. skip 10.0, 6 of 6 criteria.
